items.prompt: What evidence belongs with a strong historical strategy result before calling it out-of-sample?
items.modelAnswer: Record all tried models/tests and stopping decisions, exact time/availability/label windows, training-only transformations, untouched evaluation periods/entities, dependence/overlap handling, baseline/costs and uncertainties. A score alone is not approval to trade.
